title: Reading Practice Test 06 – Marketing & Media
description: Đề luyện Reading theo cấu trúc đề thi TOEIC (IIG Việt Nam), rút gọn 28 câu: Part 5 (10) · Part 6 (4, có câu điền cả câu) · Part 7 (14: quảng cáo, trò chuyện nhóm, bài báo có chèn câu, ba đoạn liên kết). Chủ đề: marketing, thương hiệu, khảo sát khách hàng.

questions.content: The advertising campaign was so ------- that sales doubled within a month.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc 'so + tính từ + that' → 'successful'.

questions.content: Our marketing director will present the survey results ------- the board meeting on Friday.
questions.explanation: 'at the meeting' = tại cuộc họp (sự kiện). 'present sth to someone', không phải 'to the meeting'.

questions.content: The company ------- a new logo next month to celebrate its 50th anniversary.
questions.explanation: Dấu hiệu 'next month' → tương lai đơn 'will introduce'.

questions.content: Social media has become one of the most ------- ways to reach young consumers.
questions.explanation: So sánh nhất 'the most + tính từ' bổ nghĩa cho danh từ 'ways' → 'effective'.

questions.content: ------- the budget cuts, the marketing team managed to launch three successful campaigns.
questions.explanation: Theo sau là cụm danh từ 'the budget cuts' và ý nghĩa nhượng bộ (mặc dù) → 'Despite'. 'Although' cần mệnh đề.

questions.content: Ms. Lee asked her team to finish the brochure design ------- Thursday afternoon.
questions.explanation: Hạn chót hoàn thành → 'by Thursday afternoon'. 'until' dùng với hành động kéo dài.

questions.content: The focus group participants were asked to share ------- opinions about the new packaging.
questions.explanation: Tính từ sở hữu trước danh từ 'opinions' → 'their'.

questions.content: The television commercial will be ------- during the championship game.
questions.explanation: Quảng cáo 'được phát sóng' → bị động 'will be + V3' = 'will be aired'.

questions.content: Market research shows that customers are ------- concerned about product quality than price.
questions.explanation: Có 'than' → so sánh hơn với tính từ dài: 'more concerned … than'.

questions.content: The new sports drink has been well ------- by consumers in all age groups.
questions.explanation: Bị động hoàn thành 'has been + V3'; 'well received' = được đón nhận tốt.

groups.passage:
Dear Valued Customer,

After fifteen years in business, Blue River Coffee is getting a new look. Starting May 1, our products will ---131--- in redesigned packaging made from 100% recycled materials.

Our new logo was created by local artist Mei Tanaka. ---132---. We hope you like it as much as we do.

While our packaging is changing, our recipes are not. ---133--- the same high-quality beans from our partner farms in Colombia and Ethiopia.

To celebrate the change, we are offering 20% off all online orders from May 1 to May 7. Simply enter the code NEWLOOK at ---134---.

Warm regards,
The Blue River Coffee Team

questions.explanation: Sản phẩm 'được bán' (bị động) sau 'will' → 'be sold'.

options.A: Her design reflects the rivers and mountains of our region.

questions.explanation: Câu trước giới thiệu người thiết kế logo, câu sau 'We hope you like it' → câu chèn mô tả thiết kế.
Cần mệnh đề hoàn chỉnh có chủ ngữ, nghĩa tương lai (công thức không đổi) → 'We will continue to use'.
Sau giới từ 'at' cần danh từ: 'at checkout' = ở bước thanh toán.

groups.passage:
Need more customers? PixelWave Digital can help!

We design Web sites, manage social media accounts, and create online ads for small businesses. Our clients include restaurants, dental offices, and retail shops across the region.

Book a free 30-minute consultation before June 30 and receive a complimentary analysis of your current Web site.

Visit pixelwavedigital.com or call 555-0199.

questions.content: What kind of business is PixelWave Digital?
questions.explanation: Thiết kế web, quản lý mạng xã hội, quảng cáo trực tuyến → công ty marketing số. (A), (D) là khách hàng của họ.

questions.content: What will customers receive if they book before June 30?

options.B: A free review of their Web site
options.D: A month of social media management

questions.explanation: '…receive a complimentary analysis of your current Web site' – complimentary = miễn phí.

groups.passage:
Laura Chen [9:12 A.M.]
The printer just sent the proofs for the spring catalog. Did everyone get them?

Omar Diaz [9:14 A.M.]
Yes. The photos look great, but the price on page 12 is wrong. The blender should be $79, not $97.

Laura Chen [9:15 A.M.]
Good catch. I'll let the printer know.

Kate Wong [9:17 A.M.]
Also, the cover still says "Spring 2023."

Laura Chen [9:18 A.M.]
Seriously?

Kate Wong [9:19 A.M.]
I'm afraid so. It should say "Spring 2024."

Laura Chen [9:20 A.M.]
OK. I'll send both corrections this morning. The catalogs need to be mailed by the 15th.

questions.content: What are the writers mainly discussing?
questions.explanation: Họ phát hiện lỗi giá ở trang 12 và lỗi năm trên bìa trong bản in thử (proofs) của catalog.

questions.content: At 9:18 A.M., what does Ms. Chen most likely mean when she writes, "Seriously?"

options.A: She thinks the design is too serious.
options.C: She is surprised that the error was made.
options.D: She wants to cancel the catalog.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi ý định: nghe bìa vẫn ghi năm cũ, cô ngạc nhiên ('Thật sao?'); Kate xác nhận 'I'm afraid so'.

questions.content: What will Ms. Chen do this morning?

options.C: Change the price of a product

questions.explanation: 'I'll send both corrections this morning.' Catalog gửi đi trước ngày 15, không phải sáng nay.

groups.passage:
Small Brands Turn to Micro-Influencers
By Nadia Rahman

Large companies often pay celebrities millions of dollars to promote their products online. But many small businesses are finding success with a different approach: working with micro-influencers, people who have between 5,000 and 50,000 followers on social media. [1]

Because their audiences are smaller, micro-influencers tend to have closer relationships with their followers. [2] According to a recent survey by the Digital Commerce Institute, posts by micro-influencers receive nearly three times as much engagement as posts by celebrities.

Cost is another advantage. [3] Many micro-influencers charge between $100 and $500 per post, and some accept free products instead of payment. "For a small business like ours, it's the only affordable option," said Tom Becker, owner of an organic skin-care company. [4]

questions.content: What is the article mainly about?

options.A: The rising cost of celebrity endorsements
options.B: A promotional approach popular with small businesses

questions.explanation: Bài viết về việc doanh nghiệp nhỏ hợp tác với micro-influencer để quảng bá.

questions.content: According to the article, what is an advantage of micro-influencers?

options.D: They work for several companies at once.

questions.explanation: Bài đăng của họ có mức tương tác (engagement) gần gấp ba người nổi tiếng → người theo dõi phản hồi tích cực hơn.

questions.content: The word "tend" in paragraph 2, line 1, is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: 'tend to have' = có xu hướng có → 'are likely (to have)'. 'tend' còn có nghĩa 'chăm sóc' (care) – bẫy.

questions.content:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"Their recommendations often feel more like advice from a friend than an advertisement."
questions.explanation: Câu chèn giải thích mối quan hệ gần gũi với người theo dõi, trước câu về số liệu tương tác → vị trí [2].

groups.passage:
FitLife Member Survey – Key Results (1,200 responses)

• 68% of members use the gym in the evening (after 5 P.M.)
• 54% would like more group classes
• 41% learned about FitLife from friends or family
• 22% learned about FitLife through social media ads
• Most requested new class: indoor cycling

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

To: Marketing Team
From: Jordan Ellis
Date: October 3
Subject: Survey follow-up

Hi team,

Thanks for your work on the member survey. Based on the results, I'd like to make two changes this quarter. First, since so many members joined because of personal recommendations, let's launch a referral program: members who bring a friend who signs up will receive one free month. Second, let's add the most requested class to the schedule at our downtown location, at the time of day when most members visit.

Priya, please draft the referral program announcement by Friday. Marcus, please coordinate with the downtown manager on the new class.

Jordan

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

FitLife Downtown – Class Schedule (starting November 4)

Monday – Yoga – 7:00 A.M.
Tuesday – Indoor Cycling – 6:30 P.M.
Wednesday – Pilates – 12:00 P.M.
Thursday – Indoor Cycling – 7:00 A.M.
Friday – Strength Training – 6:00 P.M.

questions.content: What is indicated by the survey?

options.A: Most members exercise in the evening.
options.C: Social media ads attracted most members.
options.D: Members are unhappy with the prices.

questions.explanation: '68% of members use the gym in the evening' → phần lớn tập buổi tối. (C) sai: chỉ 22%.

questions.content: Why does Mr. Ellis propose a referral program?

options.A: Social media ads were too expensive.
options.B: Members requested it in the survey.
options.C: Many members were introduced to FitLife by people they know.
options.D: The downtown location has few members.

questions.explanation: E-mail: 'since so many members joined because of personal recommendations'; khảo sát: 41% biết qua bạn bè, gia đình.

questions.content: What is Priya asked to do?
questions.explanation: 'Priya, please draft the referral program announcement by Friday' → soạn thông báo. (A) là việc của Marcus.

questions.content: Which class was most likely added as a result of Mr. Ellis's e-mail?
questions.explanation: Lớp được yêu cầu nhiều nhất là indoor cycling, mở vào khung giờ đa số hội viên đến (buổi tối) → thứ Ba 6:30 P.M. (kết hợp ba đoạn).

questions.content: What will members who refer a new member receive?
questions.explanation: 'Members who bring a friend who signs up will receive one free month.'
